data.name: Basic Geokinesis
data.description: Element earth; Type utility (Sp); Level 1; Burn 0 You can move up to 5 pounds per kineticist level of rocks, loose earth, sand, clay, and other similar materials up to 15 feet as a move action. You can search earthen and stone areas from a distance as if using the siftAPG cantrip.
